symptom: `return replace($S, 'a', 'b');` passed `mxcli check -p` and `exec`, then MxBuild reported CE0117 "Error(s) in expression" (Mendix CLI 2: CE7811 "Unknown function 'replace'"). `mxcli syntax microflow.expressions.functions` listed `replace(String, String, String)`.
file: mdl/exprcheck/func_checker.go funcTable (the `replace` row, removed); mdl/exprcheck/unknown_funcs.go nearestFunc (sorted candidates). Test: mdl/exprcheck/unknown_funcs_test.go TestUnknownFunctionCalls; fixture mdl-examples/check-gap/fixtures/f09_badfunc.mdl on the check-gap branch
cause: funcTable is documented as every Mendix built-in and UnknownFunctionCalls (MDL044) trusts it, so one row for a function Mendix does not have makes the call valid to mxcli and the generated syntax docs. The string replacers are replaceAll and replaceFirst.
insight: **A wrong row in funcTable is a false negative in MDL044 and a false claim in the generated docs at once, and the fastest way to find one is to run a function name through an independent checker, not to read the table.** Found by the check-gap parity run (one broken script per miss, mxcli check -p vs mx check vs mendix check): only 1 of the 5 misses was a missing rule, this one was a wrong data row. Fixing it exposed a second defect: nearestFunc iterated the map, so replace (one edit from both replaceAll and replaceFirst) suggested one or the other at random per run; it now walks sorted names. Control: replaceAll and replaceFirst still pass; revert the row removal and TestUnknownFunctionCalls fails with the reported symptom (expected unknown func, got none).
